description:
Modify the configuration of the existing 'example-repo-local' repository in JFrog Artifactory.

Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Local, then click on 'example-repo-local' to edit it. Update the following fields with EXACTLY these values:

1. Description: Production artifacts for the commons library team
2. Includes Pattern: org/apache/**,com/google/**
3. Excludes Pattern: **/*-SNAPSHOT*/**
4. Notes (internal description): Managed by Platform Engineering. Contact: platform-team@example.com

After setting all four fields, save the configuration.

The Artifactory UI is accessible at http://localhost:8082 and you are logged in as admin (password: password).

metadata.expected_description: Production artifacts for the commons library team
metadata.expected_notes: Managed by Platform Engineering. Contact: platform-team@example.com
